method: 8-connected components at alpha > 127 (solid) and > 16 (visible edge) on the raw sheet; a component belongs to the cell holding most of its pixels; cells are forge_core.rounded_grid_boxes; specks are forge_core.alpha_hygiene('both') counts
notProven: Whether an overhang is intended art such as a tail or weapon trail.
Whether a cell's pose, anatomy or identity is correct; run sheet_qc.py frames and look at the frames.
That a different crop or slicing method would be safe: only the nominal grid was measured.

checks.note: solid parts crossing a cell line are cut or misassigned when the sheet is sliced
the same test on the visible edge (alpha > 16)
art touching the sheet border was cut by the image edge
the first 96 cells must each hold a subject
solid pixels within 1 px of a cell line; a different crop or rounding can cut them
owned art closer than 1% of the cell to its edge; ask for more margin next time
alpha haze and detached specks; process removes them with --alpha-hygiene both
